subject: English
passage: Zawadi Mansour and Jing Ito used spectral data from well-catalogued meteorite samples to train an algorithm to classify mineral compositions. When tested on newly recovered meteorites from Antarctica, the algorithm ______ identified the dominant minerals in the vast majority of cases and even distinguished between olivine- and pyroxene-rich varieties. Mansour expects the algorithm to improve on this already-strong performance as additional samples are processed.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer because 'reliably' means consistently and dependably. The passage states that the algorithm identified dominant minerals in 'the vast majority of cases' and even distinguished between olivine- and pyroxene-rich varieties, and it describes this output as 'already-strong performance.' Together these clues point to an algorithm that classified samples in a consistent, dependable way.
